neet_phy_u08_t05_2.working: COP = T2/(T1 - T2) = 250/50 = 5. Minimum work W = Q2/COP = 1000/5 = 200 J.

neet_phy_u08_t05_3.working: Heat flowing through a finite temperature difference cannot be reversed by an infinitesimal change, so it is irreversible. The other three processes are ideal reversible ones.

neet_phy_u08_t05_4.working: Isothermal expansion absorbs Q1 at T1 (II). Adiabatic expansion lowers the temperature from T1 to T2 (IV). Isothermal compression rejects Q2 at T2 (III). Adiabatic compression raises the temperature from T2 to T1 (I).

neet_phy_u08_t05_5.working: A is false: Carnot efficiency is independent of the working substance. B is true by Carnot's theorem. C is true: free expansion is irreversible. D is true: a reversible process must be quasi-static and free of dissipation. E is false: 0°C is 273 K, not 0 K, so efficiency is below 100%.
